scope: Independent daily CSI adaptation of Song et al. (2026); original minute-level CSI results are not reconstructed
features: Official Qlib Alpha158 expressions, applied to adjusted daily prices and observed share volume
price_adjustment: raw price multiplied by positive finite vendor cumulative adjustment factor
label: adjusted_VWAP[t+1+h]/adjusted_VWAP[t+1]-1
purge: remove train/validation decision dates whose final 10-session label exit crosses the split; keep test decision dates through July31 with later exits only for label completion
missing_features: training-only finite mean imputation, standard deviation scaling, clip to [-10,10]
missing_labels: finite final-horizon common stock set, mask missing intermediate horizons
loss: population cross-sectional standardized MSE separately per date and per available horizon mask; equal date weight
horizon_selection: random equal support/query dates inside a 20-date batch, one differentiable SGD look-ahead with student writeback; Adam logits, entropy regularization; validation final-horizon checkpoint; retrain argmax
sweep: all10 horizons times5 seeds; all fitting and BLO selection finish before any held-out metrics
test_selection_policy: best test horizon and correlation of test-IC ranks with weights are descriptive only; never choose or tune the selected model using test data
statistics: daily cross-sectional IC and RankIC against a fixed10-session return, descriptive ICIR/RankICIR, top-decile10-session return; no naive annualized Sharpe
differences_from_public_demo: CSI constituent-specific fits instead of all A shares
paper month ranges rather than2020-2026 demo ranges
training-only mean/std imputation instead of classified tanh/full-row deletion
no training-threshold trimming of held-out returns
paper-style standardized MSE, date batches and mean-level warm-up instead of demo SGD minibatches/difference-label warm-up/ensembled trajectories
limitations: daily source cannot supply original minute patches, transaction counts or intraday targets
community snapshot values and historical membership are not independently vendor-certified
cumulative adjustment-factor semantics are inferred from source-provider documentation and checked corporate actions
gross horizon returns omit tradability constraints, costs, ladder accounting and cashflow attribution
Disjoint support/query decision dates can have overlapping future return windows; meta-query dependence remains within training batches
